componentCatalog.contract: Native Watermark and bounded shared working subquotas. Final tumbling/sliding/session aggregates with stable RowIds. Keyed tumbling and sliding windows with count, sum or avg can emit inserts, updates with before images, and deletes. The window state retains the revision and published value through checkpoint recovery. eventDeduplicate keeps the first row per key until its event-time TTL reaches the Watermark. eventJoin emits inner matches within the configured inclusive time difference. Deduplicate and join drop rows at or behind the common Watermark. Session remains final-only. General trigger policy, full CDC retractions and distributed state/rescaling are not established. First-N probes still require explicit Debug.

microBatchRows and microBatchMs group complete source transactions. A sealed epoch stores original watermarks and the last log position. SQL Server sends bounded ordered statement batches. limitations: No arbitrary global distributed transaction or general exactly-once guarantee
Advanced protocols, CDC/SCD/Fuzzy and BI Planner remain outside the current core acceptance
Single-session container transactions; arbitrary resource combinations and transactional child checkpoints are rejected before effects
Query/Schema enumerators have no reproducible external snapshot token and reject checkpoint resume
Recovery plans serialize tree scheduling; operator partitions merge in deterministic partition order
Source ranges and round-robin partitions are stable logical row positions; file partitions scan the authorized immutable source instead of assuming record-safe byte offsets
Driver/external RSS is outside the native allocator quota; benchmark RSS is measured separately
Advanced SSIS components and BI Planner remain their existing Planned/Partial status; all 69 goals are retained
Pool reuse requires UD_CONNECT_POOL and a successful native reset_session; unknown third-party session state is closed instead of reused
PostgreSQL module requires libpq >=17 for nonblocking cancellation; tested against a disposable local server, without production connections
Float64 SUM preserves serial input order and reports effective partition count 1; integer/Decimal SUM uses exact private 256-bit partial state and checks the public range only at final output
Runtime task/pipeline diagnostic records are bounded at 1024/256 and report dropped counts; callback events remain the complete optional host stream
Windows is exempt by explicit user instruction; no Windows compilation, runtime or binary certification is claimed
Execution caches require one builder and do not publish from an active transaction; cross-execution reuse is not implicit.
Incremental confirmation is a whole-DataFlow receipt barrier; active-transaction incremental sources are explicitly Unsupported.
Canonical SQLite exact NUMERIC/Decimal and PostgreSQL unbounded numeric or timestamp without time zone require a supported declared domain instead of guessed conversions.
Immutable journal Wire payloads remain owned by the state directory through resume; the host retires that directory after retention requirements are met.
ABI 7 row identity/rule metadata increases sort spill traffic. The matching CSV workload regressed against the historical ABI 6 baseline; six workload results do not imply a universal speedup.

MySQL/MariaDB claim a unique receipt inside the business transaction before effects; missing-receipt gap probes are removed. Serializable isolation is preserved.

decisions: Existing Native formula JSON AST and direct SSIS text must bind one IR. Append-only Derived could not express replacement or original-input reads. Generic UTF8/Int64 erased SSIS domains.
File record errors must retain source position and typed original business columns. XLSX raw cells must use the same record-error contract.
The 50K seven-target real workload exposes transaction receipt lock ordering and aggregate state allocation, which small isolated tests cannot prove.

designReviews.scope: Public contracts, ownership and product behavior
decisions: A scalar metadata POD extends Native Field; all values still use Native Data, Wire, Arrow and Journal. DateTime preserves 100ns and offsets. Protocol family 11 is one clean break.
Derived binds expressions against immutable original input and executes one row-atomic write plan. Replace retains field position and identity; expression lineage records its actual sources.

C# and Java functions/components register through Native Registry. Borrowed callback views expire; owned Native results and delegate/global references have explicit releases. The designer uses Worker Native compilation.
Receipt insertion and business effects share one driver transaction; conflicts verify existing receipts, never infer commit from retries.

A transaction owner stages its completion snapshot before prepare. Journal publication, business effects and confirmation counters use the same coordinator decision; recovery skips committed user code.

No independent Windows SSIS/Oracle/vendor environment means only that acceptance is blocked. Native code gaps and vendor equivalence gaps remain explicit, and release readiness fails until all mandatory gates pass.

evidenceScope.oracle: Independent Python business arithmetic and OOXML input fixtures are validation tools, never Microsoft SSIS Golden and never production execution code.
evidenceScope.parallelism: Configured Worker concurrency is recorded alongside actual Native high-water marks; a shared serializable transaction can serialize pipeline work.
evidenceScope.throughput: Nominal execution and crash/recovery timings are separate. Fast confirmation of already committed data is not bulk throughput.

latestAcceptance.remainingCode: See each matrix entry; complete cast legality, LCID inheritance/comparison, exact type inference, proprietary transforms, complete script/preview surfaces and older enterprise extensions are not complete.

designer3.ownership: Package, schemas, ports, expressions, row processing, commit/recovery facts and test snapshot identity are Native-owned. Management authorizes and dispatches; React edits and renders metadata.

designReviews.scope: Current source evidence and user actions
conclusions: The global deployment action could bypass the editor draft; publication now receives the current document and never dispatches execution.
Previous edge viewers required normal destination execution; a bounded Native execution mode now excludes destinations, control tasks and source confirmation.
Driver values are actual authorized Native module paths, discovered from Native plugin metadata; UI driver aliases are retired.
File inference, formulas, port binding, schemas and sample rows come from Native APIs through the same Worker. Typed batches and sample buffers remain Native-owned and bounded.
Package and component identities are stable UUIDs; user labels live in the versioned Native layout. Cache keys include the complete inspection scope.
Native test snapshots resolve bound port references before changing Package identity. Isolated targets use cloned connections and rebound transaction participants; source connections stay unchanged.

designReviews.scope: Side effects, recovery, concurrency and delivery
conclusions: Preview denies external writes and limits source output, rows, retained bytes and time. SQL table previews require an explicit driver read-only scan capability; arbitrary SQL, scripts, CDC and control effects are rejected.

items.blocked: Current reference lookup is not event-time as-of table lookup or generally versioned dynamic refresh.
Watermark-bounded inner interval match with inclusive bound; inputs are insert-only, rows at or behind the common watermark are dropped. No general outer/retracting/distributed join.
Keeps the first row per key until event-time TTL expires at the common watermark. Not an unbounded/global deduplication guarantee.
Native CDC row/time options group complete source transactions; general Package trigger/scheduling is not this capability.
Bounded queue/working/spill quotas and node limits are not a general source rate governor.

Keyed tumbling/sliding count, sum and average may emit insert/update/delete (update/delete include the before image as applicable) changes with checkpointed published state; session remains final-only. No generic CDC retractions.
response/idempotent/receipt modes use one Native path; unknown commit is not safe blind replay. Includes local fixture source, not external endpoint crash/replay evidence.

Existing Catalog-owned partition specs are used; native-created tables are unpartitioned. No remote object-store credential/maintenance guarantee or general standalone SQL DELETE. Real Trino fixture not certified by CORE.
PostgreSQL TLS CDC insert, Kafka refund/duplicate, current MySQL lookup, SQL/Trino net 70 and same-ID resume with one snapshot; not production-wide mutable CDC or distributed exactly-once.

currentComparativePlan.goal: Fresh Windows/Linux installed C/.NET/Java path with the same Package and correctness-checked results; no source build required for users. Record cold start and first result (proposed target ≤10 min).
Record guarantees by source/state/sink, include unknown-commit and kill-after-sink-before-offset replay, validate output loss/duplicates and RTO/RPO; show safe action in Designer.

Repeat fixed batch workload, broker-fed steady stream, long soak and controlled failures under equal resources. Record sink-visible p50/p95/p99, sustainable rows/s and MiB/s, lag, process-tree RSS/CPU, spill and checkpoint costs.

Use one Native execution contract with small recipes, typed record/batch API and actionable diagnostics. Compare row/batch overhead, and verify first publish, failure localization and safe resume in a real browser.
Add schema evolution, temporal/upsert semantics and stronger HA or sink guarantees only where measured needs justify them; no separate shadow runtime or blanket exactly-once claim.
